args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money

The docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding, but the
implementation incorrectly used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

Switch quantize() to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66
(as required by the half-even tests).

args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

## Changes

- Switched `round_money()` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
- Behavior now matches the test expectations: `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66` (half-even).
